page.title: Learn Golf at Carmel Valley Ranch | Golf Academy

blocks.label: Introduction
blocks.body:
If you want to take your game to the next level, it’s time to go back to school—The Carmel Valley Ranch Golf Academy, that is! This personalized program includes individual guidance, playing lessons, and more.

Our Golf Academy provides the finest golf instruction with ample individual attention. It includes state-of-the-art video analysis, a maximum student-to-teacher ratio of four-to-one, on-course lessons, and professional club fitting with renowned brands such as TaylorMade and Titleist. Private options are available as well.

rows.title: One-day
rows.description: Our one-day program focuses on the three most important clubs in the bag: the driver, the wedge, and the putter. Includes a 9-hole playing lesson.

rows.title: Two-day
rows.description: Personalized instruction for all facets of the game over two days, including video analysis and a 9-hole playing lesson each day.

rows.title: Three-day
rows.description: This extensive offering includes personal coaching for every part of the student’s game, from tee to green. The program also features a state-of-the-art video swing analysis and a 9-hole playing lesson each day.

rows.title: Four-day
rows.description: The ultimate instruction package—with ample time to work out the details of your swing, your short game, your putting, the mental game, and more. Video analysis and personalized instruction are included, along with a 9-hole playing lesson each day.

rows.title: Private
rows.description: Our private school is the best way to improve your game and achieve your goals in the shortest amount of time. Whether you’re a beginner or seasoned player, this offering will allow you to spend one-on-one time with your golf professional throughout your entire stay.

tabs.name: Junior Performance Program
tabs.subtitle: Where kids call the shots
tabs.intro:
Because junior golf is as much about building confidence and good sportsmanship as cultivating a love of the game, our professional approach emphasizes fun in every aspect. New to The Ranch, our Junior Golf Program’s philosophy mirrors the mission of the Titleist Performance Institute, embracing two key ideas:

  • Create Athletes First, Golfers Second. We believe it’s much easier to create a great golfer out of a great athlete.
  • Golf Is Hard, Make It Fun. We know it takes a lot of time and effort to become proficient, so our junior program has to be a fun playing experience. That said, we encourage our juniors to play as many other sports as possible to become well-rounded athletes.

tabs.name: 3-day Junior Camp
tabs.intro: Our junior camps are a great opportunity for kids ages 6-12 to get out and learn the game of golf—while receiving professional guidance from Director of Instruction Cooper Essick and the professionals at Carmel Valley Ranch. The camps cover the full swing, short game, putting, etiquette, and on-course play. Lunch is provided each day.

blocks.label: Golf and tennis camps feature
blocks.alt: a little boy with a tennis racket looking to the side and a tennis ball flying over the net at tennis court of Carmel Valley Ranch
blocks.heading: Is your youngster into golf or tennis?
blocks.body: Our special camps at The Ranch offer excellent opportunities for professional instruction in both sports. In the course, experienced Golf Academy instructors help with swing development, the short game, putting, etiquette, and on-course play. At the River Ranch courts, our PBI tennis professional teaches fundamentals, play, match preparation, and more. Camp schedules even allow juniors to attend both sessions if they wish, with lunch included in between!

blocks.label: Cooper Essick
blocks.name: Cooper Essick
blocks.title: Director of Instruction
blocks.body:
Cooper Essick leads all golf instruction at Carmel Valley Ranch, including player development, corporate instruction, golf schools, golf activities, and junior player growth. He began his Ranch journey more than 12 years ago in outside service operations, moved into the golf shop, and became Assistant Golf Professional in 2024 before his promotion to Director of Instruction.

Cooper has coached everyone from beginners to PGA Tour players for over a decade, blending modern technology with a holistic approach. He is enrolled in the PGA Associate program and Titleist Performance Institute training. Off the course, you will find him with his two labradoodles, Duffy and Dudley.
